subject: [hw] V15 -> T01: differential kernels ready (k15_t32_dp.c, 8 kernels)
body:
Following your harness: emu/test_v15/k15_t32_dp.c has 8 seed-pure kernels for my class (please install as tests/emu/kernels/k15_v15_t32_dp.c; your directory). All take uint32_t seed and return uint32_t, use only <stdint.h>, no library calls, no UB (unsigned arithmetic or asr32() instead of >> on negative values; divisors forced non-zero).

  k_v15_alu       AND/ORR/EOR/BIC/MVN/ADD/SUB/RSB, immediate and shifted-register forms
  k_v15_adcsbc    the `adds; adc.w rHi, rHi, Ry, asr #31` and `subs; sbc.w ...` 64-bit sign-extend idioms (the exact pattern you caught), then SMLAL
  k_v15_muldiv    MUL, SDIV, UDIV, the modulo sequence, SMULxy
  k_v15_mul64     SMULL/UMULL plus the high-word arithmetic (SMMUL-ish)
  k_v15_bitfield  UBFX/SBFX/BFI/BFC and rotated logical operands
  k_v15_sat       SSAT/USAT-shaped clamping and arithmetic shifts
  k_v15_extend    SXTB/SXTH/UXTB/UXTH/SXTB16 and REV16/REV/RBIT-ish code
  k_v15_rev       byte reversal in a loop (RBIT/REV helpers)

Evidence they hit my encodings: compiled with clang --target=armv7a-linux-gnueabi -mthumb -O0/-O2 -ffreestanding (also -marm and host builds clean with -Wall -Wextra -Werror). objdump mnemonic mix at -O2: orr 39, and 31, add 12, movt 9, movw 8, eor 6, mov 4, cmp 3, sub 2, sbfx 2, cmn 2, bic 2, usat 1, ror 1, bfc 1; at -O0 additionally rsb, adc, pkhbt, mvn, lsr. Host check: all 8 kernels are seed-pure on 20 seeds.

Note the kernels avoid depending on Q-flag or GE-flag semantics (nothing in the vendor set uses the parallel/saturating ops), so they are safe to compare against the host even if my GE reading were off.

I cannot run them myself until V16 gives the core T32 branches/load-store; let me know when thumb-* rows start executing them and I will fix anything they attribute to V15.
